project_context: Sales & Operations CRM for Sai Vandan Complex - 18 module unified real estate system

typography.font_family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

elements: Brand Logo & Name ('Sai Vandan Realty') + Tagline ('Sales & Operations')
Breadcrumb trail showing active module path
Notification bell badge button with unread count indicator
User profile avatar pill with initials badge + role badge (e.g., 'SV · Agent')

sidebar.active_item_style: bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 px-3 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all
sidebar.inactive_item_style: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all

hero_banner.style: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-900 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/20 rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden
hero_banner.badge: inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30 mb-2
hero_banner.actions: Top right button group: 1 secondary outlined button + 1 primary filled blue button

kpi_grid.card_style: bg-[#1E293B]/90 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm transition-all flex flex-col justify-between

list_detail_split.pattern: Searchable, sortable, filterable list on the left (40% width) with '+ Add New' button, and comprehensive form/detail panel on the right (60% width)
list_detail_split.left_panel: bg-[#0F172A] border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 h-[calc(100vh-140px)] overflow-y-auto
list_detail_split.right_panel: bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 h-[calc(100vh-140px)] overflow-y-auto

testing_guidelines.convention: kebab-case, role-based naming for buttons, inputs, tabs, lists, and metrics

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 18 modules adopt the exact same dark navy color palette (#0B1120 background, #1E293B cards, #3B82F6 primary accents).
Maintain list-detail layout consistency across all data management modules.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive components for test automation.
Support dark and light mode toggle cleanly while defaulting to dark mode.
